Commercial spaces

Spaces that work for your business.

Offices, shops and hospitality spaces designed around the people who use them.

Start with the way the space will be used.

A useful commercial brief connects the visitor experience with the everyday work behind it.

WorkplacesRetailHospitality

Arrival, shared space and quieter rooms connected in one layout.

Workplaces

Balance focused work, meetings and informal conversations. Define how teams move through the day, where privacy matters and which spaces need to adapt.

Retail spaces

Make the offer easy to understand from arrival to checkout. Consider product display, circulation, storage and the points where staff help customers.

Hospitality spaces

Connect the guest experience with service routes, back-of-house needs and a comfortable pace. Share how the space will operate before choosing its finishes.

Bring the operating details.

A floor plan, photographs, capacity needs and access restrictions help the first conversation. Include opening hours and any stages of work that must happen while the business stays open.
